notice.pl: SanAlert nie jest oficjalnym systemem ostrzegania ani kanałem administracji publicznej. Nie zastępuje syren, Alertu RCB ani komunikatów służb. Informacje pochodzą ze źródeł otwartych i mogą być niepełne lub opóźnione.
notice.en: SanAlert is not an official warning system or a government channel. It does not replace sirens, RCB alerts or instructions from the authorities. Information comes from open sources and may be incomplete or delayed.
notice.uk: SanAlert не є офіційною системою оповіщення чи каналом державних органів. Він не замінює сирен, Alert RCB і вказівок служб. Інформація походить із відкритих джерел і може бути неповною або запізнюватися.

pass_through.instruction: Whoever shows or repeats this data keeps `notice` visible with it (in the reader's language: pl, en or uk) and a visible link to every `attribution` entry, unchanged, and does not present the data as their own or as official.
pass_through.official_alarms: Always refer readers to the official air-raid alarms: sirens, Alert RCB and the instructions of the authorities. SanAlert does not replace them (NEPTUN's API terms §5).
pass_through.neptun: This data includes NEPTUN data, or is built on it: the objects tracked over Ukraine, the air-raid alarms in its districts, and SanAlert's levels, night reports and record. Keep a visible link to https://neptun.in.ua next to it, for example with the text "Дані: Карта повітряних тривог — NEPTUN" (NEPTUN's API terms §3). NEPTUN's name and logo do not pass with the data (§7).
pass_through.no_data: No data is never "quiet": when SanAlert cannot vouch for its levels, say "no data".
pass_through.levels: SanAlert's levels are its own inference from open sources, not official warnings: an object can change course. The official warnings are RCB's and RSO's.
